definitions.gloss: high praise; positive rating; favorable evaluation
definitions.explanation: A positive assessment or high rating of something. Very common in online reviews, product evaluations, and performance assessments.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高評価|こうひょうか}だ。
{高評価|こうひょうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a highly rated restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{高評価|こうひょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧おり、{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だ。
examples.english: This product has received positive reviews and its sales are doing well.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in modern Japanese, especially in the context of online reviews, ratings, and evaluations. Often used as a no-adjective: {高評価|こうひょうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高評価|こうひょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to receive high praise)
- {高評価|こうひょうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (a highly rated product)
- {高評価|こうひょうか}⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧ (positive review)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧: favorable reception — similar but emphasizes popularity
- ⟦{低評価|ていひょうか}→低評価：29868_teihyouka⟧: negative rating — the opposite
